modules.module_title: Prepare the design for IoT based system

pcs.pc_description: Collate the design and connectivity requirements to establish the inter-operability between various components of the system as per its needs
Review the specific needs of the stakeholders of an IoT system and convert them to a requirement specification document
Confirm that the software and firmware required are as per the given product specifications and system architecture

Monitor feasibility analysis of the proposed embedded product design by evaluating the required parameters such as compatibility of hardware & software, cost, space, technology, safety, functional requirements, performance requirements, etc.
Review list handshake protocols between the connected devices in the IoT system
Check all the Machine to Machine (M2M) information in a flow chart or a connected diagram that shows all inputs and outputs of the system
Check embedded OS, development machines like virtual machines, tools (cross compiler, device drivers), embedded language and GUI language required to develop the new product design
Plan to deduce security aspects to be provided in the design at all its stages and comply with globally accepted regulatory standards for technical specifications
Monitor proper coding requirements and use licensed software (or open source) as per the requirements
Check requirements for continuous integration/continuous development platform and automation test case
Test the functional specifications of each component as well as of the system
Verify technical evaluation and deployment of the overall IoT solution after discussing with experts and the internal team
Ensure the IoT based system as per quality, industry and compliance standards as well as performance and budget requirements
Supervise the personnel involved work and develop a work plan with agreed scheduled timelines
Test both high-level design document and the detailed low-level design document
Monitor specifications of the requirements, variables to be recorded, need for specific connectivity at each interface, security requirements, etc. and confirm the same with the client

modules.module_title: Use appropriate techniques to develop embedded design

pcs.pc_description: Monitor device drivers for sensors, timers, data communication ports, analog-to-digital and digital-to- analog converters and other embedded product peripherals
Check microprocessor/microcontroller software to comply with a specified function and its operating parameters
Monitor applications that perform signal processing, data acquisition, event processing, data management and communication functions
Verify that systems are using real-time embedded operating systems (OS) such as VxWorks and QNX
Ensure proper use of Opensource by understanding General Public License (GPL) detail to use re-usable components in collaboration with legal/IP team
Guide intellectual property from unauthorized use by maintaining IP confidentiality rights
Check reusable software components, best practices and design standards

modules.module_title: Test and debug the embedded system for proper functionality

pcs.pc_description: Check the Unit Test Cases (UTCs) by white box testing method
Plan to use proper testing methodologies to check that prototype devices are built as per specifications
Verify the microprocessor/microcontroller on the board and also all associated peripherals systematically
Test the performance of the prototype devices/components against product specifications and regulatory requirements
Review codes and UTCs from appropriate people to identify defects
Check inputs from concerned people to decide design corrections
Monitor bug tracking system to report problems or issues in accordance with the policy and procedure and seek guidance from the team on how to resolve them
Verify corrective actions taken for identified defects in the design to submit corrected code to concerned person for approval
